title: Procurement Three-Way Match
initial_prompt: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

stages.message: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

inputs/receipt_corrections.json voids or replaces selected receipt records by record_id (the receipt_id in goods_receipts.json). Remove a voided record; replace a selected record with its replacement object. Apply corrections before aggregation and regenerate every output.

inputs/credit_notes.xml contains line and header credits. Apply each line credit only to its referenced invoice line, cap that line at zero, and add excess to the supplier unapplied_credit. Header credits reduce the supplier total after line payables, freight, and tax, capped at zero; add any excess to unapplied_credit. Update line credit_applied and line_payable, supplier credit_applied, header_credit, unapplied_credit, and final_payable. Regenerate all files.
